{{COI|date=April 2017}}
'''Juan José Nieto Roig''' (born 1958, A Coruña) is a Spanish mathematician, professor of [[mathematical analysis]] at the [[University of Santiago de Compostela]] since 1991 and a Royal Galician Academy of Sciences Fellow. His most influential contributions to date are in the area of [[differential equations]].

Nieto received his [[bachelor degree|degree]] in mathematics at the [[University of Santiago de Compostela]] in 1980. He was awarded a [[Fulbright]] scholarship and proceeded to the [[University of Texas]] at Arlington, where he worked with professor [[Vangipuram Lakshmikantham]]. He received his [[Ph.D.]] in mathematics at the University of Santiago de Compostela in 1983.

Nieto's work may be considered to fall under the ambit of differential equations. His research interests are in [[fractional calculus]], fuzzy equations and epidemiological models. He is one of the most cited mathematicians in the world according to [[Web of Knowledge]]<ref>{{cite web |url=http://esi.webofknowledge.com/rankdatapage.cgi?option=A&searchby=F&search=MATHEMATICS&sortby=1&currpage=1 |title=Scientist Rankings in Mathematics |publisher=Web of Knowledge}}</ref> and appears in the Thomson Reuters Highly Cited Researchers list.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://hcr.stateofinnovation.thomsonreuters.com/|title=Highly Cited Researchers|publisher=Thomson Reuters|access-date=2016-04-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161205140036/http://hcr.stateofinnovation.thomsonreuters.com/|archive-date=2016-12-05|url-status=dead}}</ref> Nieto has also occupied different positions in the University of Santiago de Compostela, such as [[Dean (education)|Dean]] of Mathematics and Director of the Mathematical Institute. He has also participated as editor in different mathematical journals, being [[editor in chief]] of the journal ''Nonlinear Analysis: Real World Applications'' from 2009 to 2012.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://xornal.usc.es/xornal/acontece/2016_04/noticia_0190.html |title=Juan José Nieto ingresou na Real Academia Galega de Ciencias |publisher=University of Santiago |access-date=2016-04-28 |archive-date=2016-05-02 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160502094103/http://xornal.usc.es/xornal/acontece/2016_04/noticia_0190.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 2016, Nieto was admitted as a Fellow of the Royal Galician Academy of Sciences.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ragc.gal/es/noticias/el-prof-dr-d-juan-jose-nieto-roig-ya-es-academico-numerario-de-la-ragc |title=El Prof. Dr. D. Juán José Nieto Roig ya es Académico Numerario de la RAGC |publisher=Royal Galician Academy of Sciences |access-date=2016-04-28 |archive-date=2016-08-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160814032509/http://www.ragc.gal/es/noticias/el-prof-dr-d-juan-jose-nieto-roig-ya-es-academico-numerario-de-la-ragc |url-status=dead }}</ref>
